scope: From the seat of the employer-founder (Daniel, for his company). What counts as wages: s 9AA(1) with s 9BA (fringe benefits, FBT-exempt benefits out), s 9CB(1) (super), s 9GA (employment agents), s 9HB (GST excluded), and regs 5-6 (the one prescribed contractor class: ship and boat building labour contracts, with its exclusions); WA taxable wages (s 5(2)) and s 6A(1) with ss 6B, 6C read as facts; grouping (ss 30, 31(1)-(2), 32(2), 33(1)(a), (2)-(5)) and exclusion (s 38(1)-(2)); joint and several group liability (s 7(2)); the $1,000,000 annual, $83,333 monthly and $7,500,000 upper thresholds and the tapering value (s 8); annual liability of a local nongroup employer for a whole or part year (ss 10, 11A) and of a group for a whole year (s 17(1)-(2), (3A)); the rate (Pay-roll Tax Act s 5: 5.5% from 1 July 2023; in the sliding scale period, Table item 1 and the ss 6(2), (3) and 10(3), (4) formulas); when an employer must apply to register, within 7 days, and the $20,000 penalty (s 24(1), (2), (5)); monthly returns within 7 days or 21 for June, and tax due then (ss 26(1), (3), 6). Not encoded: interstate nongroup employers (ss 13-16); progressive monthly liability and reconciliation (ss 11, 12, 15, 16, 19, 20); group part-years (s 17(3)-(7)); the 2019-20 half-year rules (s 7A, Div 6) and sliding scale rates for progressive return periods (Pay-roll Tax Act ss 7, 9, 11); valuation detail (ss 9BB-9BI, 9CC-9CD, Subdiv 4-6, ss 9HA, 9HC); s 6A(2)-(8) and ss 6B-6D in detail; s 21; tracing (ss 34-37); the DGE (s 39); Part 5 exemptions (asked as a fact); s 29 and reg 48; ss 41-42C; machinery.
seat: the employer-founder: Daniel, asking for his company, Jarrah Legal Technologies Pty Ltd
